Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shear Line
Issued at: 11:00 PM, 24 November 2025(Monday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon(Sariaya, Lucena, Tayabas, Lucban, Mauban, Sampaloc, Pagbilao, Atimonan, Agdangan, Padre Burgos, Unisan, Plaridel, Pitogo, Gumaca, Lopez, Macalelon, Quezon, Alabat, Perez, Tagkawayan, Guinayangan, Calauag, Buenavista, San Narciso, San Andres, San Francisco, Mulanay, Catanauan, General Luna).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate rains over Bulacan, Nueva Ecija, Pampanga, Cavite, Tarlac, Zambales and Bataan within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Rizal, Laguna, Metro Manila, Quezon(Candelaria, Dolores, San Antonio, Tiaong, General Nakar, Infanta, Real, Burdeos, Jomalig, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Polillo) and Batangas(Talisay, Tanauan, Santo Tomas, Malvar, Lipa, Padre Garcia, San Juan, Rosario, Taysan, Lobo, Batangas City, Ibaan, San Jose, Cuenca, Balete, Mataasnakahoy, San Pascual, Alitagtag, Santa Teresita, San Nicolas, Taal, San Luis, Bauan, Mabini, Agoncillo, Laurel, Lemery, Calaca) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 AM tomorrow.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
